messages:
oliver: opened a docs PR to correct the /v1/rerank API examples and schema mismatch: some examples use `query` singular and show a single `score` in the response, but the runtime and SDKs expect `queries` (array) and return `scores` (array). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12999
meera: thanks. which files are affected? I can help update JS + curl snippets
oliver: affected files: api-reference/rerank.md, examples/rerank/curl.md, examples/rerank/js.md. root cause: a historical doc patch accidentally reverted the batch request shape to the single-query version. OpenAPI and SDKs were fine, but the example page and a few code snippets were inconsistent.
docs-ci-bot: docs-lint: fail 
- request example body property `query` not in schema for POST /v1/rerank (expected `queries`)
- response example property `score` does not match OpenAPI response schema (expected `scores`)
meera: yikes. customers could be misled when porting example code. can you paste corrected curl + JS snippet and a minimal response sample so I can sanity-check?
oliver: corrected curl snippet below (normalized header casing to `x-request-id`):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/rerank-v1","queries":["Which is best?","Which is cheapest?"],"candidates":["Plan A","Plan B","Plan C"]}'
```
meera: looks good. JS snippet?
oliver: JS snippet (fetch):
```
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${RDW_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-request-id': requestId
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    model: 'redwood/rerank-v1',
    queries: ['Which is best?', 'Which is cheapest?'],
    candidates: ['Plan A', 'Plan B', 'Plan C']
  })
});
const body = await res.json();
console.log(body.scores);
```
meera: and the minimal corrected response sample?
oliver: corrected response (200):
```json
{
  "id": "rr_01G...",
  "model": "redwood/rerank-v1",
  "scores": [0.92, 0.45, 0.33],
  "usage": {"input_pairs": 6}
}
```
support-bot: linked support ticket #SUP-4590 where a customer used the singular `query` snippet and got a 400 from their strict client expecting an array. Adding the migration note helped resolve that case.
meera: I'll update the markdown pages and add a short migration note: "Older examples that show `query` (singular) should be updated to `queries` (array). Responses return `scores` array aligned with `candidates` order."
janet: for the release notes: include the PR link and a one-line migration tip for integrators. also, if docs CI on release branch flags this, prefer reverting the doc snippets rather than delay a code release.
docs-ci-bot: re-run: examples validated against OpenAPI now: pass \u2705
oliver: added a tiny test follow-up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4355 to snapshot the rerank examples (request keys + response keys) so we don't regress. rebasing and will merge after final review. thanks! :shipit:
